title: Let the test launcher stop a detached run on macOS and Linux, so a superseded remote FULL can be cancelled instead of running to completion
outcome: Let the test launcher stop a detached run on macOS and Linux, so a superseded remote FULL can be cancelled instead of running to completion
acceptance: The supported launcher stop cancels a detached focused or full run on macOS and Linux: it ends that run's own process group and records the run as cancelled, without touching processes outside the run
A test covers stopping a detached run on a POSIX host, and the existing Windows job-supervisor stop behaviour and tests are unchanged

completion.summary: Delivered supported detached POSIX launcher cancellation with owned-group cleanup and regression coverage; landed the exact reviewed and full-gated candidate on master, pushed and installed it after all six live stores reported ready.
